bio.text: Eric Buckson represents the 16th District in the Delaware State Senate; he was first elected in 2022 and is serving his second term.
Buckson is a lifelong resident of Kent County and a retired educator in the Polytech School District.
Before the Senate he served as a commissioner on the Kent County Levy Court.
Buckson graduated from Caesar Rodney High School in 1983 and the University of Delaware in 1988, and earned a master's degree in Sport Management in 1990.
